title: Treasury coupon announcement (2Y + 5Y + 7Y notes, 2Y FRN, 6/13/26-week bills) — January's month-end block, released two hours before the 10-Year TIPS auction it shares a session with
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by the treasury-10y-tips-2027-01-21 initial research, text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised. Seven securities carry `Thursday, January 21, 2027` as their announcement date, read verbatim from that text: `13-Week  BILL` and `26-Week  BILL` (auctioned Monday, January 25, 2027), `6-Week  BILL` (Tuesday, January 26, 2027), `2-Year  NOTE` (Monday, January 25, 2027), `5-Year  NOTE` (Tuesday, January 26, 2027), `2-Year  FRN` (Wednesday, January 27, 2027) and `7-Year  NOTE` (Thursday, January 28, 2027) — the four coupons all settling Monday, February 01, 2027. The 11:00 a.m. ET announcement time is Treasury convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-10y-tips-2027-01-21 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09). PROPOSED BECAUSE IT SHARES ITS PROPOSER'S SESSION, and that overlap is a measured structural feature rather than a coincidence. The sibling treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19 ledger found the same shape one quarter earlier — Treasury announcing an entire month-end coupon block at ~11:00 a.m. ET, two hours before a 10-Year TIPS auction's 1:00 p.m. bidding deadline — and measured it to 6 of 7 years since 2019 for the November slot. This is the January instance of the same overlap, and it is the reason the proposer's ledger warns that its auction's tape is not clean of supply news. HONEST CALIBRATION ON HOW MUCH IT MATTERS, carried forward from that sibling: the four nominal coupons will already have been sized by the quarterly refunding statement (2026-11-04 for this window), so the 11:00 print is normally a confirmation with low surprise potential; the part that can still be new is the BILL block, where Treasury's refunding statements reserve flexibility in writing. This slot also lands on the FIRST month-end block of 2027 and D-6 to fomc-2027-01-27, inside the blackout that opens 2027-01-16. Proposed as an estimate; `symbols: []` and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
